course.title: Linear Integrated Circuits and Digital Systems

content.value: Write down the advantages of active filter over passive filter. Design a second order wide bandpass active filter with $f _ { L } = 2 0 0 ~ \mathrm { H z } , f _ { H } = 2 \mathbf { k } \mathrm { H z }$ , and passband gain of 4. Also calculate the value of Q for the filter.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2021
